name: Drip Paint
desc: Threads of poured paint fall under gravity with whippy jitter, streaking and splattering into a tangled Pollock-esque field that pools and re-layers as new colors are flung each section.

density.doc: pour rate / number of simultaneous falling drips

flow.doc: gravity strength: fall speed & streak length

y.doc: pool horizon (drips slow & spread below this)
